scope: Approved R4 private preparation; future service outcomes unexecuted

method.procedure: Use one concise decision record for final candidate, final exposure and authorized protected opening. Reuse approved custody/owner decisions; keep only specific missing results and responsible actors. Walk failure/timeout/drift boundaries. Public controls, one report and anonymous access/basic use remain opening follow-up; versioned release and consumer migration remain later independent work.
method.reason: A readiness decision must reconcile real gaps and operation authority without multiplying forms or reporting pending public outcomes as executed.

observations: Three-group handoff binds final candidate, exposure and protected opening. Only concrete future operations remain: authorized adoption/integration, final post-CI refresh and named freeze/session, then attended public protection/control/report/access checks. Drift/timeout/containment review preserves explicit authority and later independent release.
